title: WhitelabelConfig
description: Configuration schema for a Lumio whitelabel distribution.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference — always point to ../../schema.json

companyName.description: Human-readable company name (e.g. 'ACME Corp'). Used in splash screen and about dialog.

productName.description: Full product name shown in Windows taskbar, macOS dock, and installer (e.g. 'ACME Nalatenschap').

appId.description: Reverse-domain application identifier. Must be unique per company (e.g. 'com.acme.nalatenschap').

colors.description: Brand color palette. Only 'primaryBase' is required; other shades can be auto-derived.

primaryBase.description: Core brand color. Used as the main primary color across the app (header, buttons, sidebar active items).

primaryDark.description: Darkest shade of the primary color. Used in dark title bar backgrounds. Defaults to 15% darker than primaryBase.

primaryMedium.description: Medium shade. Used for accent colors and focus rings. Defaults to 20% lighter than primaryBase.

primaryLight.description: Light shade. Used for hover states and secondary indicators. Defaults to 40% lighter than primaryBase.

primaryPale.description: Pale tint. Used for highlight backgrounds and selected state backgrounds. Defaults to 80% lighter than primaryBase.

primaryGhost.description: Near-white tint. Used for page background. Defaults to 92% lighter than primaryBase.

primaryForeground.description: Text/icon color on primary-colored backgrounds. Defaults to '#ffffff' (white).

titleBarColor.description: Background color of the Windows Electron title bar overlay. Defaults to colors.primaryDark.

titleBarSymbolColor.description: Color of the minimize/maximize/close icons in the Windows title bar. Defaults to '#ffffff'.

splashColor.description: Background color of the startup splash screen. Defaults to colors.primaryDark.

file.description: Filename of the logo relative to this config directory. Supported formats: PNG, SVG, JPG, WebP. Minimum recommended size: 512×512 px.

height.description: Display height in pixels of the logo overlay shown inside the app. Width scales proportionally.

opacity.description: Opacity of the logo overlay (0.1 = almost invisible, 1.0 = fully opaque). Slightly transparent looks more natural.

showOnSplash.description: If true, the company logo is shown centered on the startup splash screen in addition to in-app overlays.

useAsAppIcon.description: If true, the logo file is used to generate the Windows .ico, macOS .icns, and Linux .png app icons. Requires the build-time engine (WL-4).

dashboardMessage.description: Optional short message shown in a subtle footer bar on the Dashboard page only. Intended for HR/IT messages (e.g. 'Aangeboden door ACME HR. Vragen? hr@acme.nl').

hexColor.description: CSS hex color in 3- or 6-digit form (e.g. '#1a3a5c' or '#fff').
